app/composables/adminFetch.ts.reason: The one sanctioned cast (design D-FETCH): every admin call site goes through adminFetch<T>(). The second match is the doc comment quoting the pattern it replaces.

app/composables/publicFetch.ts.reason: The public site's one sanctioned cast (design D-FETCH, lot G): every public call site goes through publicFetch<T>(), a bare call of the global $fetch (no header forwarding: the SWR cache invariant). Kept apart from adminFetch so a public page never inherits admin-only behaviour.
